purpose: Describe an extent covering a substantial time or area.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
N + にわたって / にわたり; N + にわたる + N
The meeting continued for three hours.
A power outage affected a wide area.
formation: N + にわたって / にわたり; N + にわたる + N
restrictions: Emphasizes the whole span, often a long period or broad range.
mistake: Use にかけて when rough endpoints matter more than full coverage.
